# What this project is
> Plugin Autopilot is a self-hosting ChatGPT/Codex Plugin that converts agentic repositories into focused, validated, deterministically packaged Plugins. It packages and validates the same Skills it uses to convert other repositories.

## Core documentation

- [README](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/chatgpt-codex-plugin-autopilot/blob/main/README.md): Project overview, quick start, architecture, installation
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/chatgpt-codex-plugin-autopilot/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Agent interface contract — skills, scripts, operating rules
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/chatgpt-codex-plugin-autopilot/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Repository boundaries, verification gates, PR workflow, release provenance
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/chatgpt-codex-plugin-autopilot/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Vulnerability disclosure, trust boundaries, response process

## Plugin manifest

- [plugin.json](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/chatgpt-codex-plugin-autopilot/blob/main/.codex-plugin/plugin.json): Authoritative plugin metadata — version, author, capabilities, URLs
